title: Additional Plans to Improve Energy Conservation and Manage Energy Demand by Businesses and Households
what_it_is: Additional Plans to Improve Energy Conservation and Manage Energy Demand by Businesses and Households

sections.label: Energy conservation support measures
sections.summary: The Government supports energy conservation through the Energy Efficiency Grant, Demand Response and Interruptible Load programmes, higher E2F caps, simplified applications, and the Climate-Friendly Households Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The Government is committed to supporting energy conservation efforts and has recently introduced new measures, such as the Energy Efficiency Grant, which supports SMEs in the food services, food manufacturing and retail sectors to invest in energy-efficient equipment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The Energy Market Authority has also introduced Demand Response and Interruptible Load programmes that companies can participate in to optimise their energy consumption.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Under these programmes, participating companies receive incentive payments in exchange for reducing electricity consumption during periods of high electricity prices or tight supply.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: For example, the grant support cap for NEA’s Energy Efficiency Fund (E2F) for the adoption of energy-efficient technologies in manufacturing was raised this year from 50% to 70% of qualifying costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We have also simplified the application process for standard lighting and air-conditioning energy efficiency retrofit projects to encourage take-up.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We will also continue to monitor and review the Climate-Friendly Households Programme, which encourages 1-, 2- and 3-room HDB households to switch to resource-efficient and climate-friendly refrigerators, LED lamps and shower fittings.

sections.label: E2F and EETC support
sections.summary: E2F has supported 34 companies since 2019, and EETC completed low-cost energy assessments of over 100 energy consuming systems covering over 20 manufacturing SMEs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, E2F has supported 34 companies since 2019, whilst EETC has completed low-cost energy assessments of over 100 energy consuming systems covering over 20 manufacturing SMEs.

sections.label: Climate-friendly household vouchers
sections.summary: If everyone uses the vouchers for energy-efficient refrigerators, shower fittings and LED lights, energy consumption will be significantly reduced.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, for the climate-friendly households, if everybody utilises the vouchers and get more energy-efficient refrigerators, shower fittings, LED lights, clearly, there will be a significant reduction in energy consumption.
